product_metadata.title: Dragon Backflow Incense Holder with 100 Cones, 7.5 Inch High Waterfall Backflow Incense Burner Gift Crafts Home Decor
features: ✅ Material: Ceramic. Exquisite Workmanship, Handmade crafts & Unique design, Beautiful Home Decor & Exquisite Gifts.

✅ Mysterious Atmosphere: The smoke steam down like a waterfall, the cone incense burner surrounded by smoke, which looks wonderful. Note: Choose a flat and windless place for the best viewing effect.

✅ Handmade and unique gift: Backflow incense holder is made of ceramic material, of high beauty and elegance. The delicate and elegant incense holder is a unique gift for family, friends and loved ones, expressing your love for them. This is also an excellent decoration for your house or classical furnishings.
